season.label: LIVE 2026-27, retrospective forecasts (not timestamped before kickoff)
season.wording: Parameters were fixed before 2026-27 data was fetched. Forecasts were recomputed after the matches were played and are not timestamped before kickoff. Team ratings update with each result as it arrives.

ratings.label: DESCRIPTIVE: final filter states after the 2026-27 snapshot; no test, no claim
ratings.defence_bar_note: Defence bars do not narrow with more matches. This most likely reflects how the model's variance behaves. A simulation reproduced the signs but could not separate this from team selection, so treat it as unconfirmed (see ratings_check.md).
ratings.interval: exp(centred mean minus sd) to exp(centred mean plus sd); approximate, coverage not checked
